recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is recommended unless a future work group decision reverses the R6 all-normative/current no-trial-use policy for these Attachment elements.
issue_request: FHIR-23568 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to add Media-derived size metadata to the Attachment datatype as part of the Media-to-DocumentReference merge, with the modification that the new elements be marked STU.
initial_application: The Media merge work added Attachment.height, Attachment.width, Attachment.frames, Attachment.duration, and Attachment.pages. Commit 63ea1b517ff4c332398b40659e92bef9e675865e explicitly applied FHIR-23568 by adding a Standards-Status column and trial-use values to those five elements.
additional_context: Attachment is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini and is currently listed as normative. Commit 7466cfc63cd0b162497a42c80a67480eed86c75a later removed the Attachment trial-use cells during R6 standards-status cleanup, and source/versions.html now states that the current specification is fully normative and no content is considered trial-use.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Re-adding the old STU markers would conflict with the current R6 source policy, while the substantive Attachment elements requested by the issue remain present in build-scoped source.
